description: This file defines the SingleNoteWidget class, an Android AppWidgetProvider responsible for managing a widget that displays a single note in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles widget updates, deletion, and broadcasting updates, and interacts with the NotesRepository to fetch and remove widget-specific data.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidget
classes.description: An Android AppWidgetProvider that manages the display and lifecycle of a single note widget, including update, deletion, and broadcast handling.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called when the widget needs to be updated; triggers the updateAppWidget method.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents received by the widget, including refresh requests.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Called when the widget is deleted; removes associated widget data from the repository.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Static method that updates each widget instance with the latest note data and sets up the widget views.

methods.name: updateSingleNoteWidgets
methods.description: Static method to broadcast an update to all single note widgets.
